payload.reason: The evidence provides multiple instances of evaluating the generalization ability of the NCEL model across different datasets, indicating a systematic approach to verify its performance.

claims.text: The generalization ability of NCEL is verified by evaluating it on five different benchmarks after training on Wikipedia hyperlinks.
NCEL consistently outperforms various baselines, demonstrating favorable generalization ability across multiple datasets.
The effectiveness of NCEL's generalization ability is assessed through experiments on five publicly available datasets.
